title: Golden Gate Level 0 Assembly Protocol
author: Vinca Seiler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8edhta6
materials: 0.5 µL of entry Vector (15 ng/ μL)

steps.title: Add DNA insert
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 µL of DNA insert at a concentration of 60 ng/µL to the Golden Gate assembly reaction.

steps.title: Transform competent cells
steps.instruction: Add 2–5 µL of each assembly reaction to 50 µL of competent cells.

steps.title: Recover transformed cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the transformed cells for 1 hour when selecting with ampicillin, or for 2 hours when selecting with kanamycin or chloramphenicol.
